svg.text: Onboarding flow · new and returning users
Apple / Google sign-in · pairing required · one shared anniversary
Get started · I already have an account
Apple or Google · “Welcome back” for returning users
Saves the draft name + date, if any
Clear errors: invalid · expired · your own
Updates by itself · expired → make a new code
One button → iOS prompt · no “Not now”
Location-off state + Open Settings if denied
No unpaired Home: unpairing (either partner) returns to Connect with your partner.
Anniversary: the code creator’s date wins; if they skipped it, the joiner’s date is used.
Email sign-in postponed · location rechecked on every launch (and after a reinstall).
First setup ends with a one-time welcome · notifications are asked when sending the first heart.
